lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨੈ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevanai kee aas karahi jam nihaarai saasaa ||
lines.translation: You hope for long life, while Death counts your breaths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੀਗਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਚੇਤਿ ਢਾਲਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: baajeegaree sa(n)saar kabeeraa chet dhaal paasaa ||3||1||23||
lines.translation: The world is a game, O Kabeer, so throw the dice consciously. ||3||1||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਪੁਨ ਰਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਉ ਪਾਚਉ ਤਤ ਬਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan rainee man pun rap kar hau paachau tat baraatee ||
lines.translation: I make my body the dying vat, and within it, I dye my mind. I make the five elements my marriage guests.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਭਾਵਰਿ ਲੈਹਉ ਆਤਮ ਤਿਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam raai siu bhaavar laihau aatam tih ra(n)g raatee ||1||
lines.translation: I take my marriage vows with the Lord, my King; my soul is imbued with His Love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਉ ਗਾਉ ਰੀ ਦੁਲਹਨੀ ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaau gaau ree dulahanee ma(n)galachaaraa ||
lines.translation: Sing, sing, O brides of the Lord, the marriage songs of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere grih aae raajaa raam bhataaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord, my King, has come to my house as my Husband. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੇਦੀ ਰਚਿ ਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naabh kamal mahi bedee rach le braham giaan uchaaraa ||
lines.translation: Within the lotus of my heart, I have made my bridal pavilion, and I have spoken the wisdom of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੋ ਦੂਲਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਸ ਬਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam raai so doolahu paaio as badabhaag hamaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: I have obtained the Lord King as my Husband - such is my great good fortune. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਕਉਤਕ ਆਏ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਉਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar mun jan kautak aae kot tetees ujaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: The angles, holy men, silent sages, and the 330,000,000 deities have come in their heavenly chariots to see this spectacle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਹਿ ਚਲੇ ਹੈ ਪੁਰਖ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੨॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer mohi biaahi chale hai purakh ek bhagavaanaa ||3||2||24||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I have been taken in marriage by the One Supreme Being, the Lord God. ||3||2||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਸਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੇਠ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਡਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas kee dukhee sasur kee piaaree jeth ke naam darau re ||
lines.translation: I am bothered by my mother-in-law, Maya, and loved by my father-in-law, the Lord. I fear even the name of my husband's elder brother, Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਨਨਦ ਗਹੇਲੀ ਦੇਵਰ ਕੈ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਜਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahelee nanad gahelee devar kai birahi jarau re ||1||
lines.translation: O my mates and companions, my husband's sister, misunderstanding has seized me, and I am burning with the pain of separation from my husband's younger brother, divine knowledge. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਬਉਰੀ ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਰਹਉ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree mat bauree mai raam bisaario kin bidh rahan rahau re ||
lines.translation: My mind has gone insane, since I forgot the Lord. How can I lead a virtuous lifestyle?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜੈ ਰਮਤੁ ਨੈਨ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਉ ਇਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾ ਸਉ ਕਹਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sejai ramat nain nahee pekhau ihu dukh kaa sau kahau re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He rests in the bed of my mind, but I cannot see Him with my eyes. Unto whom should I tell my sufferings? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਪੁ ਸਾਵਕਾ ਕਰੈ ਲਰਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਦ ਮਤਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: baap saavakaa karai laraaee maaiaa sad matavaaree ||
lines.translation: My step-father, egotism, fights with me, and my mother, desire, is always intoxicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਡੇ ਭਾਈ ਕੈ ਜਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bade bhaaee kai jab sa(n)g hotee tab hau naah piaaree ||2||
lines.translation: When I stayed with my elder brother, meditation, then I was loved by my Husband Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੰਚ ਕੋ ਝਗਰਾ ਝਗਰਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer pa(n)ch ko jhagaraa jhagarat janam gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, the five passions argue with me, and in these arguments, my life is wasting away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothee maaiaa sabh jag baadhiaa mai raam ramat sukh paaiaa ||3||3||25||
lines.translation: The false Maya has bound the whole world, but I have obtained peace, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||3||3||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਤਨਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤਾਨਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਨੇਊ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham ghar soot tanahi nit taanaa ka(n)th janeoo tumaare ||
lines.translation: In my house, I constantly weave the thread, while you wear the thread around your neck, O Brahmin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਤਉ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tumh tau bed paRahu gaaitree gobi(n)d ridai hamaare ||1||
lines.translation: You read the Vedas and sacred hymns, while I have enshrined the Lord of the Universe in my heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਨੈਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree jihabaa bisan nain naaraain hiradai basahi gobi(n)daa ||
lines.translation: Upon my tongue, within my eyes, and within my heart, abides the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਬ ਪੂਛਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਸਿ ਮੁਕੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam duaar jab poochhas bavare tab kiaa kahas muka(n)daa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When you are interrogated at Death's door, O mad-man, what will you say then? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗੋਰੂ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਆਰ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham goroo tum guaar gusaaee janam janam rakhavaare ||
lines.translation: I am a cow, and You are the herdsman, the Sustainer of the World. You are my Saving Grace, lifetime after lifetime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਚਰਾਇਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kabahoo(n) na paar utaar charaaihu kaise khasam hamaare ||2||
lines.translation: You have never taken me across to graze there - what sort of a herdsman are You? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਬਾਮੑਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਮੋਰ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) baamhn mai kaaseek julahaa boojhahu mor giaanaa ||
lines.translation: You are a Brahmin, and I am a weaver of Benares; can You understand my wisdom?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਤਉ ਜਾਚੇ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਮੋਰ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: tumh tau jaache bhoopat raaje har sau mor dhiaanaa ||3||4||26||
lines.translation: You beg from emperors and kings, while I meditate on the Lord. ||3||4||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਸਮਾਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag jeevan aisaa supane jaisaa jeevan supan samaana(n) ||
lines.translation: The life of the world is only a dream; life is just a dream.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਗਾਠਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saach kar ham gaath deenee chhod param nidhaana(n) ||1||
lines.translation: Believing it to be true, I grasped at it, and abandoned the supreme treasure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਹਿਤੁ ਕੀਨੑ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa maaiaa moh hit keenh ||
lines.translation: O Father, I have enshrined love and affection for Maya,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨੑ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin giaan ratan hir leenh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: which has taken the jewel of spiritual wisdom away from me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਉਰਝੈ ਪਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: nain dekh pata(n)g urajhai pas na dekhai aag ||
lines.translation: The moth sees with its eyes, but it still becomes entangled; the insect does not see the fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaal phaas na mugadh chetai kanik kaamin laag ||2||
lines.translation: Attached to gold and woman, the fool does not think of the noose of Death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar bichaar bikaar parahar taran taaran soi ||
lines.translation: Reflect upon this, and abandon sin; the Lord is a boat to carry you across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥੫॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer jagajeevan aisaa dutee naahee koi ||3||5||27||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, such is the Lord, the Life of the World; there is no one equal to Him. ||3||5||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:
